limitations: Strict categorization is a conservative manual judgment of direct manuscript-format relevance, not a statement that auxiliary submission forms have no value.
The 120 created runs are primarily the beginning of an ordered sheet, not a representative random sample of remaining journals.
Strict success measures acquisition of format-related original files; it does not measure general page-reading ability or the incremental benefit of webpage-only copies.
Cloud session figures are recorded usage charges before credits/promotions, not invoice payments.
The provider and collector can still expose old versions; latest-version correctness is not established.
This evaluates bu-ultrafast with the existing prompts, domain policy, timeout and local downloader, not the best possible Browser Use setup.
recommendation: Worth a small controlled top-up after fixing policy cleanup, quota stop and semantic acceptance; do not resume all pending entries unchanged.
